name: MultiLangNG
project_description:
The future is: TranslationBliss 
 So long, and thanks for all the fish!

Please switch to TranslationBliss , which should do everything this module does, and more!

 The module provides currently one submodule: 

 multilangng_translations 
 An alternative service that translates config at runtime. Which brings some advantages:

 
 Fixes [#2806009] 
 Fixes [#3336537] 
 Allows translating non-english config 
 Allows contextual translation of config strings 
 Allows auto translation of sitebuilder config 
 
 See README .

 If you use it, pleas provide feedback at [#3336532].

 You can help ove this to core in [#3336728]
